newsitem.title: JAPAN: Moody's rates TEPCO's 1 bln mark bonds Aaa.
newsitem.headline: Moody's rates TEPCO's 1 bln mark bonds Aaa.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Friday it had assigned an Aaa rating to Tokyo Electric Power Co Inc's (TEPCO) 4.75 percent bonds worth one billion marks maturing in 2002.
The rating is based on TEPCO's importance to the national economy and the very favourable industry operating environment, the rating agency said.
Moody's also said it expects that a favourable operating environment will continue to allow TEPCO to operate with a low degree of industry risk.
